version.description: Policy spec version. Must be "0.1" for this schema.

strict.description: If true, warning-level findings count as failures for exit-code purposes.

rules.description: Map of CCI ID (CCI-NNN) to per-rule configuration.

severity.description: Override the rule's severity. 'off' disables the rule entirely.

allow.description: Per-file allow exceptions. Order does not matter.

reason.description: Free-text justification. REQUIRED. Surfaced in scan output.

id.description: CCI ID (CCI-005), detector name (t5.unsafe_shell_install), threat category (T5), or literal '*'.

detail_tags.description: Specific detail_tag values to allow. Empty/omitted = all tags for this rule.

extends.description: Reserved for v0.2 (base-policy inheritance). Rejected in v0.1.

actors.description: Reserved for v0.2 (author-identity allow rules). Rejected in v0.1.

metadata.description: Reserved for v0.2 (free-form team metadata). Rejected in v0.1.

notify.description: Reserved for v0.2 (notification channels). Rejected in v0.1.
